messages.subject: CmdStan v2.8.0 is out now
messages.body_plain:
CmdStan v2.8.0 is available now: https://github.com/stan-dev/cmdstan/releases/tag/v2.8.0

If you want to use CmdStan directly, download using the links to cmdstan-2.8.0.tar.gz <https://github.com/stan-dev/cmdstan/releases/download/v2.8.0/cmdstan-2.8.0.tar.gz> or cmdstan-2.8.0.zip <https://github.com/stan-dev/cmdstan/releases/download/v2.8.0/cmdstan-2.8.0.zip>. All required libraries are included in these files.

As always, if you have issues, please reach out to us on the stan-users mailing list <https://groups.google.com/d/forum/stan-users>.

Daniel

messages.subject: RStan v2.8.0 is on CRAN!
messages.body_plain:
RStan v2.8.0 is out now. Most of the improvements for this version come from updates to the Stan Math Library.

For release notes, see the RStan news page: https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/rstan/NEWS

- Stan Development Team
